purpose: Test whether the already-frozen Phase-1 Severity challenger score carries stable 15m/30m ordering information beyond State+shock-age, and whether a symmetric fixed calibration layer converts that ordering into stable probability-score improvement. Phase-1 remains NOT_SUPPORTED.

ordering_test.development: use Phase-1 2021-2023 LOYO out-of-fold scores exactly as stored
ordering_test.repeat_audit: use Phase-1 fixed 2024-2025 scores exactly as stored

calibration.method: Platt scaling applied symmetrically and separately to B and C
calibration.model: intercept plus one slope under binomial log-likelihood
calibration.development: second-level leave-one-year-out: fit calibrator on the other two years' Phase-1 OOF scores and apply to held year
calibration.repeat_audit: fit calibrators once on all 2021-2023 Phase-1 OOF scores and apply unchanged to 2024-2025

ordering_acceptance_gates: development family-adjusted trading-day bootstrap lower bound for raw-score AUROC gain > 0
at least 2 of 3 development years have raw-score AUROC gain >= 0
each symbol development raw-score AUROC gain >= 0
each of 2024 and 2025 repeat-audit raw-score AUROC gain >= 0
each symbol repeat-audit raw-score AUROC gain >= 0
calibrated_increment_acceptance_gates: development pooled cross-fitted calibrated Brier gain > 0
development pooled cross-fitted calibrated LogLoss gain > 0
at least 2 of 3 development years have both calibrated Brier gain >= 0 and calibrated LogLoss gain >= 0
each of 2024 and 2025 repeat-audit years has both calibrated gains >= 0
each symbol repeat-audit has both calibrated gains >= 0

verdicts.ORDERING_AND_CALIBRATION_SUPPORTED_PENDI: ordering and calibrated increment gates both pass
verdicts.ORDERING_ONLY_CALIBRATION_NOT_SUPPORTED: ordering gates pass but calibrated increment gates fail
